chapter: Gillespie and Carter on John Collins
title: Carter on Collins's underrated place and influence
summary: Carter says Collins is not underrated by those who know him, agrees critics ignore him, and believes later guitarists were influenced by him.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: I'm very foggy about that. You know, John is really one of my favorite guitarists. A lot of people say he's underrated but he's not underrated. He's just not rated by people who don't know him.
Yeah, he was --
You know, we that know him really don't underrate him, you know.

Yeah, that's what I was telling him because I had this big stack of jazz books here while we were talking and he went through them as I had done and he's not in any of them. All he's in is Leonard's Encyclopedia and the Who's Who of Jazz by Chilton.
That's ridiculous.
Nobody mentions him.
Isn't that ridiculous?
But all the musicians who've always wanted him, you know --
That's right.
-- but he's never had any kind of public acclaim, he's never been written about, the critics ignore him and --
I don't understand why.
I don't either. You keep saying, "Why"?
I don't know.
I mean Dizzy said -- he gave me a couple of statements -- he said that he felt that he was possibly the most important guitarist in jazz and someone that he had learned a lot from.

And John started doing it so much earlier than all the -- then when these other guys came along and I'm sure that practically all of them have listened and listened to and gained from and been influenced by John Collins.
That's what Dizzy was saying.
Oh sure, there's no doubt of it.
So I just thought I would ask you how you felt his place was or what you thought his place was in the whole scheme of things and the progression of the instrument and the music?
Well, I don't -- I don't know how to, you know, state that, you know. I would certainly say he is -- he should enjoy a very, very important place.
Um hmmm.
I certainly believe that, you know.
Yeah, because I wanted to ask you
since apparently your association has been a very, very long one.
Well, it certainly has from my side.
Yeah.
I think he shares that.
Yes, well he's very enthusiastic about having worked with you and continuing as recently as I guess last winter, right?
Definitely, yeah.
